run_img2img_generation: run the StableDiffusionXLImg2ImgPipeline to generate an image from a prompt and input image
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method
prepare_latents_from_image: prepare latent representations from an input image using the prepare_latents method
configure_denoising_timesteps: configure custom denoising timesteps using get_timesteps with strength and denoising_start parameters
apply_ip_adapter_embeds: prepare and apply IP Adapter image embeddings using prepare_ip_adapter_image_embeds for image conditioning
